summary: Sunshine Biopharma filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that, due to recent sales of common stock under its previously disclosed at-the-market offering, the exercise price of its outstanding Series B Warrants was reduced to $1.2046, subject to further adjustment under the warrant terms. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or transaction is involved. This is a routine contractual anti-dilution price reset triggered by ATM issuances, not a special situation. Watch for further dilution from warrant exercises and additional ATM sales pressuring the common stock.
